name: Veszprémgalsa (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Veszprémgalsa (a green and blue shield with white flowers, a crown and a bridge) between the year 2000 above and the name VESZPRÉMGALSA below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
